hook: Drilling small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand.
hooks: Drilling small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand.
Scoring grooves crack metal, but hole lines avoid that failure.
Create complex curves with just a drill and patience, no fancy tools.
what_happened: John drilled small holes along each curved fold line, then bent the aluminum by hand to create the desired shape.
why_it_matters: It lets you shape curved metal without expensive machines, removing the tool bottleneck.
the_catch: The finished part has visible perforations, the process is slow, and it hasn’t been proven on thick steel.
caption: Drilling a line of small holes lets you fold curved aluminum sheets by hand without fancy tools. Could you replace a scoring groove with this hole‑perforation technique on your next project?
alt_text: The carousel explains that drilling a series of tiny holes along a curved line creates a weak spot that lets you bend aluminum by hand, avoiding cracks and fancy equipment.

es.hook: Taladrar pequeños agujeros permite doblar láminas de aluminio curvadas a mano.
es.what_happened: John taladró pequeños agujeros a lo largo de cada línea de pliegue curva, luego dobló el aluminio a mano para crear la forma deseada.
es.why_it_matters: Permite dar forma al metal curvo sin máquinas costosas, eliminando el cuello de botella de la herramienta.
es.the_catch: La pieza terminada tiene perforaciones visibles, el proceso es lento y no se ha demostrado en acero grueso.
